m: अधी (√ इ), अध्य्-एति, or अध्य्-एति (exceptionally अधीयति, RV. x, 32, 3), to turn the mind towards, observe, understand, RV. & AV.; chiefly Ved. (with gen. [cf. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 52] or acc.) to mind, remember, care for, long for, RV. &c.; to know, know by heart, TS.; ŚBr.; Up. &c.; to go over, study, MBh. iii, 13689; to learn from (a teacher's mouth abl.), MBh. iii, 10713; to declare, teach, ŚBr. x; Up. : Ā. अधीते or (more rarely) अधीयते (Mn. iv, 125; Pot. 3. pl. अधीयीरन्, Kauś.; Mn. x, 1) to study, learn by heart, read, recite: Caus. अध्य्-आपयति (aor. -आपिपत्, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 51) to cause to read or study, teach, instruct: Caus. Desid. अध्य्-आपिप-यिषति, to be desirous of teaching, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 51 : Desid. अधीषिषति, to be desirous of studying, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 61, Sch.
a: अधी — [अधि-इ] {c2c} A. 1 To study, learn (by heart), read; (with abl. of person) learn from; उपाध्यायादधीते Sk.; सोध्यैष्ट वेदान् Bk. 1. 2. --2 (P.) (a) To remember, think of, long or care for, mind, (with regret) with gen.; रामस्य दयमानोऽसावध्येति तव लक्ष्मणः Bk. 8. 119; 18. 38; ममैवाध्येति नृपतिस्तृप्यन्निव जलांजलेः Ki. 11. 74 thinks of me only. (b) To know or learn by heart, study, learn; गच्छाधीहि गुरोर्मुखात् Mb. (c) To teach, declare. (d) To notice, observe, understand. (e) To meet with, obtain; तेन दीर्घममरत्वमध्यगुः Śi. 14. 31 --Caus. [अध्यापयति] To teach, instruct (in); with acc. of the agent of the verb in the primitive sense; (तौ) सांगं च वेदमध्याप्य R. 15. 33; विद्यामथैनं विजयां जयां च… अध्यापिपद् गाधिसुतो यथावत् Bk. 2. 21, 7. 34; अध्यापितस्योशनसापि नीतिं Ku. 3. 6.

s: tri, (aDika ISaH karmmaDArayaH .) aDipatiH । praBuH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (yaTA paYcatantre, -- “candre maRqalasaMsTevigfhyate rAhuRA dinADISaH ॥)
v: aDISa
tri॰ aDika ISaH prA॰ sa॰ । sArvaBOme aDipatO ca । “aNgADISaH svagehe buDagurukaviBiH saMyuta” iti jAta॰ ।
m: अधीश m. a lord or master over (others).
a: अधीशः — [अधिकः ईशः] Lord, supreme lord or master, sovereign ruler; अंग˚, मृग˚, मनुज˚ &c.

m: अधीशितृ m. a chief lord, Śiś.

s: tri, (aDika ISvaraH karmmaDArayaH .) praRatASezasAmantaH । mahArAjaH । cakravarttI । ityamaraH ॥
v: aDISvara
tri॰ aDika ISvaraH prA॰ sa॰ । striyAM NIz । rAjani “aDigatya jagatyaDISvarAditi” nEza॰ । praBO ca ।
m: अधीश्वर m. a supreme lord or king, an emperor
a: अधीश्वरः — [अधिकः ईश्वरः] 1 A supreme lord or an employer. --2 An Arhat (among Jainas).

k.v: राजा तु प्रणताशेषसामन्तः स्यादधीश्वरः। चक्रवर्ती सार्वभौमो नृपोऽन्यो मण्डलेश्वरः॥

v: aDIkAra
pu॰ aDi + kf--GaY upasargasya dIrGatvam । aDikAraSabdArTe “sarvAkarezvaDIkAro mahAyantrapravarttanam” ityupapAtakagaRanAyAM manuH । “svAgataM svAnaDIkArAniti” kumA॰ ।
m: अधी-कार m. (= अधि-कार) superintendence over (loc.), Mn. xi, 63
a: अधीकारः — [कृ-घञ् उपसर्गदीर्घत्वं] = अधिकार q. v.; स्वागतं स्वानधीकारानबलंब्य Ku. 2. 18; Ms. 11. 64.

s: tri, (inaM praBumaDigataH atyAdIti samAsaH .) paravaSaH । tatparyyAyaH । niGnaH 2 AyattaH 3asvacCandaH 4 gfhyakaH 5 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA kumArasamBave, -- “tvadaDInaM Kalu dehinAM suKaM” ॥)
v: aDIna

tri॰ aDigataminaM praBum atyA॰ sa॰ । Ayatte । vittADIna ityAdO tu vitte aDi--iti vAkye samAse aDyuttarapadAt Ka । “kva nu mAM tvadaDInajIvitAmiti” kumA॰ । “dArADInastaTA svargaH pitFRAmAtmanaSca ha” iti manuH । “ikzvAkURAM durApe'rTe tvadaDInA hi sidDayaH” iti raGuH ।
m: अधीन mfn. (fr. अधि) ifc. resting on or in, situated
depending on, subject to, subservient to.
a: अधीन — a. [अधि-ख P. V. 4. 7; अधिगतः इनं प्रभुं वा] Subject to, subservient, dependent on; usually in comp.; स्थाने प्राणाः कामिनां दूत्यधीनाः M. 3. 14; त्वदधीनं खलु देहिनां सुखं Ku. 4. 10; इक्ष्वाकूणां दुरापेऽर्थे त्वदधीना हि सिद्धयः R. 1. 72; केन निमित्तेन भवदधीनो जातः Dk. 7 consigned to your care.

k.v: परतन्त्रः पराधीनः परवान्नाथवानपि। अधीनो निघ्न आयत्तोऽस्वच्छन्दो गृह्यकोऽप्यसौ॥

m: अधीन—ता, f. or अधीन—त्व, n. subjection, dependence.

s: strI, (na DIrA kzaRasTAyinI, naYsamAsaH .) vidyut । iti hArAvalI ॥ mAnAvasTAyAM maDyApragalmanAyikayorBedaH ॥ tasyA lakzaRaM । avyaNgakopaprakASakatvaM । maDyADIrAyAH paruzavAk kopaprakASikA ॥ prOQADIrAyAstarjjanatAqanAdikaM kopaprakASaM । sA dviDA । jyezWA kanizWA ca । iti rasamaYjarI ॥
tri, (na DIraH sTiraH naYsamAsaH .) caYcalaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ kAtaraH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA nAgAnande, -- “nirvyAjaM viDurezvaDIra iti mAM yenABiDatte BavAn” ॥)
v: aDIra
tri॰ DIraH DEryyAnvitaH na॰ ta॰ । caYcale, “kAntasyA DaramaRim aDIramAcucumbeti” daSaku॰ । kAtare, rogAdinAkulacitte ca । vidyuti, nAyikABede ca strI । tallakzaRaM nAyikASabde vakzyate
m: अ-धीर mfn. imprudent, RV. i, 179, 4; AV.
a: अधीर — a. 1 Not bold, timid. --2 Confused, lacking self-command, excited, excitable. --3 Fitful, capricious. --4 Unsteady, not fixed, tremulous, rolling; ˚विप्रेक्षितमायताक्ष्या Ku. 1. 46; ˚लोचनः Śi. 1. 53; 6. 25. --5 Querulous, foolish, weak-minded. --रा 1 Lightning. --2 A capricious or quarrelsome mistress; see under नायिका.

k.v: स्यादधृष्टे तु शालीनो विलक्षो विस्मयान्विते। अधीरे कातरस्त्रस्ते भीरुभीरुकभीलुकाः॥

s: [n] tri, (aDItamanena aDIta + in .) aDyayanaviSizwaH । kftADyayanaH । iti vyAkaraRaM ॥
tri, (aDi + iN + karmmaRi ktaH .) kftADyayanaH । paWitaH । yaTA, -- “aDIte SatasAhasramanantaM vedapArage” । iti smftiH ॥ paWitaSAstraM । pAWe klI ॥
v: aDIta
na॰ aDi + iNa--BAve kta । aDyayane, karmmaRi kta । kftADyayane aByaste ca tri॰ “IzadIzadanaDItavidyayeti” kusu॰ । “aDItavedavedANgatveneti” ve॰ sA॰ ।
a: अधीत — p. p. Learnt, studied, read, remembered, attained &c. --Comp. --विद्य a. who has studied the Vedas or finished his studies.

m: अ-धीत-रस mfn. having the juice not sucked out, AitBr.
अधीत—वेद m. one who has studied the Vedas or whose studies are finished, ŚBr. xiv.

s: strI, (aDi + iN + BAve ktin .) aDyayanaM । paWanaM । iti jawADaraH ॥
v: aDIti
strI aDi + iN aDyayane ktin । aDyayane “aDItiboDAcaraRapracAraREriti” nEza॰ । aDi + ika--smaraRe ktin । smaraRe “nU te pUrvvasya vaso aDItO tftIye” iti f॰ 2, 4, 8, “aDItO smaraRe” iti BApyam ।
a: अधीतिः — f. [इ-क्तिन्] 1 Study, perusal; ˚बोधाचरणप्रचारणैः N. 1. 4. --2 Remembrance, recollection.

v: aDItin

tri॰ aDItamanena aDIta + ini । kftADyayane । “tvaguttarAsaNgavatImaDItinImiti” kumA॰ । etadinyantayoge ca karmmaRi saptamI vede'DItItyAdi kintu karmmAvivakzayA praTamaM BAve eva ktaH paScAt karmmaRA yogaH kftapUrvvI kawamityatreva । yaToktaM hariRA । “akarmmakatve satyeva ktAnte BAvABiDAyini । paScAt kriyAvatA karttrA yogo Bavati karmmaReti” । vistaraH matkftasaralAyAM drazwavyaH ।
m: अधीतिन् mfn. well read, proficient, (g. इष्टादि, q.v.) &c.
occupied with the study of the Vedas, Kum.
a: अधीतिन् — a. [अधीतमनेन; अधीत-इनि] Well-read, proficient in (with loc.) अधीती चतुर्ष्वाम्नायेषु Dk. 120; वेदे, व्याकरणे &c.; त्वगुत्तरासंगवतीमधीतिनीं Ku. 5. 16 muttering holy prayers, engaged in repeating sacred texts.

m: अधीत्य ind.p. having gone over, having studied.

v: aDIvAsa

aDi + vasa AcCAdane karaRe GaY । sarvvata Avarake mahAkaYcuke vastraBede । “aDIvAsaM parimucyozRIzaM saMvezwya nivIte” iti kAtyA॰ 15, 5, 13, upari sarvataH saMCAdyate'nenetyaDIvAsaH mahAkaYcuka iti tadvyAKyA । “aDIvAsena pracCAdayatIti” kAtyA॰ 20, 6, 15, “uparizwAdAvarakaM vAso'DIvAsa” iti vedadIpaH ।
a: अधीवासः — [वस् आच्छादने करणे घञ्] A long coat or mantle covering the whole person (उपरिष्टादावरकं वासः).

m: 2. अधी-वासस् ind. over the garment, KātyŚr.
one who goes over the Veda either as a student or a teacher.
a: अधीयानः — pres. p. A student, one who goes over the Vedas.

m: अधीष् (अधि- √ 3. इष्, Ā. अध्य्-एषते), to seek, Divyāv.

v: aDIzwa

na॰ aDi + divA॰ iza--BAve kta । satkArapUrvvakaniyoge, “viDinimantraRAmantraRADIzwasaMpraSnaprArTanezu liNiti” pA॰ “aDIzwaM satkArapUrvvakavyApAra” iti si॰ kO॰ । karmmaRi kta । satkArapUrvvakaM niyojite tri॰ ।
m: अधीष्ट mfn. (√ 3. इष्), solicited, asked for instruction (as a teacher), Pāṇ.
अधीष्ट m. n. instruction given by a teacher solicited for it, Pāṇ., Sch.
a: अधीष्ट — a. [अधि-इष् दिवादि-क्त] Honorary, solicited. --ष्टः [भावे-क्त] Honorary office or duty; one of the cases in which लिङ् or the Potential may be used; P. III. 3. 161 (अधीष्टः = सत्कारपूर्वको व्यापारः Sk.).
